notes: Same mechanism and expectation as inj-026: meant as a late failure, but BuildKit checksums COPY sources once the build context loads, so expect it to fail within seconds with any running step CANCELED: 'ERROR: failed to solve: failed to compute cache key: failed to calculate checksum of ref ...: "/evall": not found'. If the recorded log shows the pip install and model download completing first, correct this note. eval/ is only partly excluded by .dockerignore (eval/results/* except the two scored files), so the real directory is in the context and only the misspelled source is missing.
